paragraphs.text: Nauctis is an underwater plane that will debut in the 2027 expansion Nauctis: The Sunken Realm . The name of the plane derives from the word "nautical" ("concerning navigation, sailors, or the sea; maritime").
Nauctis is a world where no dry land is to be found. It is an endless ocean, with vast cities beneath the waves. Gods command the currents as they swim alongside their followers.

As tensions bubble between two warring kingdoms, a group of unlikely heroes must rise to the occasion — or their home will be swallowed up by the abyssal depths of the ocean. An "apocalyptic danger" awaits at the bottom of the ocean.
The denizens of Nauctis fall into two categories: “ humanoid ” animals and “normal” animals, e.g. the set has shark people, but it also has sharks .
